I did not buy "Diamond Life" when it first came out... It was a huge hit, esp in the cities of America.
I first remember hearing, "Hang On to Your Love"... followed in quick succession by "Your Love is King" and "Smooth Operator"... each blowing up in turn.

SADE TURNED US OUT!!! 🤣🤣

EVERYONE... Esp every man I knew... was talking about her... Praising her... Raving about her!!

and quickly, I realized something.... WOMEN WERE PISSED THE F' OFF ABOUT THAT!!! LMAO!!
I NEVER heard a man disparage her... but women talked about her like a DOG!!!

That kinda of OBSESSED JEALOUSLY I had never witnessed before, regarding a musical artist!! 🤣🤣
Women were seriously MAD!!

THAT SHIT WAS TRIPPY!!!


I got "Promise" on CD when I bought my very first CD player in 1985. I already had the album on cassette and I spent a day comparing the two ... tape vs CD... sonically. 
And was amazed at the very subtle tones/elements that I could hear on CD that were not present on cassette.

I've listened to "Promise"... MANY HUNDREDS OF TIMES!!
Had to wait THREE LONG YEARS before she released "Stronger Than Pride"... by that time my young life had taken a big turn --- graduated from Univ, moved into my first apt and then my second apt, promotions at work, had been thru a series of girlfriends... and all of them HATED SADE!!!! LMAO!!!! ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Was that because I was always playing her first two albums?? ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

lastly.... I must say... I'm shocked that "War of the Hearts" is NOT considered one of her GREATEST songs of all time!!

There are several of her VERY BEST songs that are missing from this playlist... SHOCKINGLY MISSING!!
Which makes me wonder if the DJ is a big fan or just capitalizing on the music. I could replace several songs on this list with MUCH BETTER SONGS.

Beginning with "WAR OF THE HEARTS"!

What a beautiful memory of the beginning of Sade’s journey. ❤️🎶
“Hang On to Your Love,” “Your Love Is King,” and then “Smooth Operator” — what an incredible run of songs. ✨
